placements.title: Stances that anchor downstream navigation
placements.frame: What organizational stance does this content establish that downstream work connects to?

placements.title: From renting intelligence to owning it
placements.frame: What does owning rather than renting one's intelligence make commodity, and what does it make the asset you keep?
placements.why: src-2 and src-3 perform the owned-versus-rented intelligence distinction as a thematic thesis — substrate is commodity, perspective is the retained asset. This is a subject future envelopes can feed, not a one-time fact. No existing leaf holds this theme.
